description: Aménagements cyclables is a dataset listed in Ville de Meudon open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Seine Ouest. Localisation des aménagements cyclables et des zones de circulation apaisée sur Meudon Un aménagement cyclable est un dispositif de voirie destiné à organiser la circulation des cycles non motorisés. Ces aménagements peuvent prendre la forme de chaussées dédiées aux cyclistes ou d'espaces pris sur la voie publique. Coverage: Meudon. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité, Vélo. Its keywords are Plan climat, Vitesse, Zones, Routes, Vélos, Aménagements cyclables. The portal shows 484 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-03-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-meudon-fr-portal.
